scope: Model-based equity/EV smoke test, fixed public-history diagnostics and local production-sampling latency. No guaranteed profit or equilibrium claim.

beforeBatch.actionRateDefinition: Observed action counts / all recorded actions on that street; these are not a player's decision probabilities.
beforeBatch.profileDefinition: Fictional simulation parameters, not descriptions of the real people.
beforeBatch.continuationDefinition: C-bet opportunities use the last preflop raiser facing no flop bet. Value bets count too. Delayed c-bets require a checked-through flop; turn barrels continue the last flop aggressor. Policy reasons are counted separately.
beforeBatch.unopenedRangeMethod: Exact 1326-combination enumeration of entry and sizing proposals before shared EV selection; these are not observed action frequencies.

performance.note: Logged samples describe estimates attached to actions; cached worlds may be reused. Timings are measured on this machine, not deterministic output.

performance.note: Logged samples describe estimates attached to actions; cached worlds may be reused. Timings are measured on this machine, not deterministic output.

strategyDiagnostics.definition: Observed decisions for fixed public histories over reproducible seeds and all seven simulation profiles. C-bets use the last preflop raiser and an unopened flop, including value bets; reason counts report policy branches separately. These are not population poker frequencies.
strategyDiagnostics.isolationDefinition: Legal sizing proposals before EV selection; unreachable limper counts are omitted and a BB walk has no decision.

0.reason: No opponent remains; the big blind has no decision.

productionBenchmark.note: Fresh decision engines and complete hands measured at production sampling; wall times vary by machine and process warm-up.
productionBenchmark.processCondition: Dedicated fresh Node process before any other decision analysis; firstDecisionMs excludes module import time.
